name: Perfect numbers k: k is equal to the sum of the proper divisors of k.
formula: The perfect number N = 2^(p-1)*(2^p - 1) is also multiplicatively p-perfect (i.e., A007955(N) = N^p), since tau(N) = 2*p. - _Lekraj Beedassy_, Sep 21 2004
a(n) = 2^A133033(n) - 2^A090748(n), assuming there are no odd perfect numbers. - _Omar E. Pol_, Feb 28 2008
a(n) = A000668(n)*(A000668(n)+1)/2, assuming there are no odd perfect numbers. - _Omar E. Pol_, Apr 23 2008

name: Period 2: repeat [0, 1]; a(n) = n mod 2; parity of n.
Jacobsthal sequence (or Jacobsthal numbers): a(n) = a(n-1) + 2*a(n-2), with a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; also a(n) = nearest integer to 2^n/3.
formula: G.f.: x/(1 - x - 2*x^2) = x/((x+1)*(1-2*x)). _Simon Plouffe_ in his 1992 dissertation

name: Mersenne exponents: primes p such that 2^p - 1 is prime. Then 2^p - 1 is called a Mersenne prime.
formula: a(n) = log((1/2)*(1+sqrt(1+8*A000396(n))))/log(2). - _Artur Jasinski_, Sep 23 2008 (under the assumption there are no odd perfect numbers, _Joerg Arndt_, Feb 23 2014)
a(n) = A000120(A000396(n)), assuming there are no odd perfect numbers. - _Omar E. Pol_, Oct 30 2013

name: Number of unlabeled rooted trees with n nodes (or connected functions with a fixed point).
formula: Also A(x) = Sum_{n>=1} a(n)*x^n = x / Product_{n>=1} (1-x^n)^a(n).
Recurrence: a(n+1) = (1/n) * Sum_{k=1..n} ( Sum_{d|k} d*a(d) ) * a(n-k+1).

name: a(n) = binomial(3*n,n)/(2*n+1) (enumerates ternary trees and also noncrossing trees).
Least integer of each prime signature A124832; also products of primorial numbers A002110.
formula: What can be said about the asymptotic behavior of this sequence? - _Franklin T. Adams-Watters_, Jan 06 2010
Hardy & Ramanujan prove that there are exp((2 Pi + o(1))/sqrt(3) * sqrt(log x/log log x)) members of this sequence up to x. - _Charles R Greathouse IV_, Dec 05 2012

name: Double factorial of odd numbers: a(n) = (2*n-1)!! = 1*3*5*...*(2*n-1).
formula: D-finite with recurrence: a(n) = a(n-1)*(2*n-1) = (2*n)!/(n!*2^n) = A010050(n)/A000165(n).

name: Triangle of Stirling numbers of the second kind, S2(n,k), n >= 1, 1 <= k <= n.
formula: E.g.f.: A(x, y) = e^(y*e^x-y). E.g.f. for m-th column: (e^x-1)^m/m!.

name: a(n) = n^n; number of labeled mappings from n points to themselves (endofunctions).
formula: E.g.f.: 1/(1 + W(-x)), W(x) = principal branch of Lambert's function.
a(n) = Sum_{k>=0} binomial(n, k)*Stirling2(n, k)*k! = Sum_{k>=0} A008279(n,k)*A048993(n,k) = Sum_{k>=0} A019538(n,k)*A007318(n,k). - _Philippe Deléham_, Dec 14 2003
